The Unsigned Box Distance Function is a standard primitive in Signed Distance Field (SDF) rendering, often used in GLSL-based ray marchers.
While the signed variant is more common in constructive solid geometry (CSG) operations, the unsigned variant is useful for simple boundary checks or when the interior is treated as empty space.
